notes: §1985:XIV.3.4.4 GR1: "Execution of a PURGE statement causes the MCS to eliminate any partial message awaiting transmission to the destinations specified in the CD referenced by cd-name-1." BindPurge (SR1, COBOL6170) binds the statement, Emit calls MessageControl.Purge, and MessageControlSession.Purge removes the run unit's pending portion (Dialogue.Sends) for occurrences 1..DESTINATION COUNT only, or the input-output CD's terminal. The witness purges a partial and the next SEND starts a new message. Probes at 85: (a/f) partial AAA to D1 and D2, PURGE with count 1: D1 receives BBB (length 3), D2 receives AAABBB (6); count 0 30 with no action; (b) PURGE CIN refused COBOL6170, PURGE with no operand COBOL0001; no mcs.json: 20 '1'; I-O CD purge 70 then after a partial 00; (c) refused COBOL0902 at 2014/2023, COBOL0903 at 2002; (d,e) not applicable.

next.reason: 1985: "Execution of a PURGE statement causes the MCS to eliminate any partial message awaiting transmission"; 2023: "No PURGE statement; the 2023 SEND/RECEIVE candidates concern message-server run units, not CD-based MCS queues.". The 1985 Communication module, with CD and PURGE, is absent. No candidate covers purging partial messages, and the 2023 SEND/RECEIVE rules are a different message-server facility.
